status: argument proposal; not a completed essay
question: When may finite-horizon welfare comparisons justify a ranking of two infinite, temporally ordered histories?
claim: Extend a finite-prefix total-welfare comparison only when its direction is stable at every sufficiently late finite horizon; persistent sign reversal yields incompleteness under horizon-neutral robustness.
scope: temporally ordered infinite welfare streams with finite real welfare per period
no claim for arbitrarily enumerated unordered populations

definitions.weak_support: x >=H y iff exists N such that for every n >= N, D_n(x,y) >= 0
definitions.strict_support: x >H y iff exists N such that for every n >= N, D_n(x,y) > 0
definitions.incomparability: neither direction has eventual weak support
definitions.horizon_neutrality: where no terminal horizon or unbounded cutoff schedule has independent moral standing, an extension should survive every cofinal finite-cutoff inspection schedule

premises.text: The stipulated finite comparison ranks prefixes by cumulative total welfare.
An infinite comparison requires an extension beyond any one finite prefix.
No single cofinal schedule may decide the extension without an independent ethical reason.
Universal robustness over all cofinal schedules is equivalent to eventual sign stability.
premises.status: analytic equivalence stated and proved informally in proposal

premises.text: Persistent positive and negative prefix differences permit cofinal schedules with opposing verdicts.

inference.to: eventual agreement licenses a weak or strict comparison; persistent sign reversal licenses neither direction under this method

worked_cases.generalization: Any coordinatewise weak improvement with one strict finite-period improvement yields eventual strict positive cumulative difference.

worked_cases.prefix_differences: D_1=1; D_n=1 for odd n and -1 for even n
worked_cases.result: Neither direction has eventual weak support; odd and even cofinal schedules disagree.

critic_engagement.astra_contribution: Can admissible truncations be justified independently while preserving enough determinate comparisons to guide choice?
critic_engagement.response: Dominance holds in the stated model; the unresolved region size and independent defense of admissibility remain open. Familiarity risk is accepted; source review can falsify the contribution.
critic_engagement.sol_contribution: No separate new argument declared; assessor supports research priority based on formal testability and possible role for incompleteness.
critic_engagement.response_to_sol: Formal testability is not proof of ethical justification or originality.
